Being good in school doesn't predict business success much at all — running a company is mostly about sales, cash flow, hiring, and surviving setbacks, none of which show up on a transcript. If you believe in him, could you invest a smaller amount you could genuinely afford to lose and keep the emergency fund intact? Also worth asking to see his actual plan — revenue model, costs, how long until money comes in. If he can't explain that clearly, that tells you something important. And mixing money with a close friendship can strain it badly if things go sideways, so it's worth being honest with yourself about whether you'd be okay with that outcome.
